name: Terminal
included: Arbitrage-checked volatility surface for BTC and ETH, with its per-expiry error published
NSE chains through the user's own broker session, nothing stored on our side
Positions with delta, gamma, vega and theta attribution that reconciles to realised profit and loss
The user's own edge measured with a confidence interval
not_included: Recommendations, signals, advice, or anything a research analyst licence would be needed for

The broker's own data subscription, which the subscriber pays their broker directly
refund_policy: A full refund revokes access immediately. A partial refund does not.
cancellation_policy: Access continues to the end of the period already paid for.
